content.text: {"interpretation":{"name":"TightenVariantFastenersWithSharedNutrunner","scope":{"line":2,"station":"st2","tool":"NR7","variant":"F30"},"goal":"Tighten the F30 variant fasteners at station st2 of line 2 with the shared nutrunner NR7, then return the tool to the crib and release it so that the other lines are not blocked.","constraints":["NR7 must be reserved before any transport or physical use and released at the end, after it has been returned to the crib (E1, E6).","Each Step that uses the tool depends on the reserve-tool Step and renews the lease with the reservation token before physical use (E6).","The lease is 120 s and is longer than every single tool-using Step: transport 90 s, configure 5 s, tighten 60 s (E9).","transport-tool Steps must be delegated to the Executor agvexecutor (E2).","NR7 must be at station st2 before configure-tool and tighten-fasteners are invoked (E3).","The tightening program comes only from get-program for variant F30.
